# Primary-driven index builds — concept pack (small)

> Source-anchored research for Primary-driven index builds. Run status: COMPLETED.

<!-- generated by llms-concept-abstractor v1.4.1 · generated 2026-10-23 · budgeted to ≈8000 tokens; the full catalogue is llms-full.txt -->

## Structure and components

- [statement] Primary-driven index builds are replicated via startIndexBuild, commitIndexBuild, and ci/cd oplog entries. Sources: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-109664 — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/master/src/mongo/db/index_builds/README.md · keywords: Primary-driven index builds · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/master/src/mongo/db/index_builds/index_builds_coordinator.cpp

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] [redacted] records a secondary validation failure after building an index over an array-valued field: Index is not multikey but document has multikey data. The ticket lists a fix in 8.3.0-rc0. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-04-14) — https://example.test/withheld-reference

## Facts and statements

- [statement] In the development branch, primary-driven index builds (PDIB) are resumable, including across failover (stepdown/step-up); resumability work for failover was fixed in 9.0.0-rc0. An October 2026 ticket (SERVER-136189) states that PDIB are resumable and that about 10 tests still carry stale exclusions saying they are not. This does not establish availability in any deployed release. Sources: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-136189 ; https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-125827 — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/master/src/mongo/db/index_builds/README.md · keywords: Primary-driven index builds · also: https://example.test/withheld-reference, https://example.test/withheld-reference
- [statement] SERVER-127943 reports that resuming an index build does not set BulkBuilderImpl::_hasMultiKeyMetadataKeys, so for a wildcard index the build may incorrectly try to insert a multikey metadata key twice. The ticket lists a fix in 9.0.0-rc0 and a backport request for v8.3, v8.0 and v7.0; it does not confirm the backports. Sources: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-127943 — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-127943
- [statement] [redacted] warns that internal commit-quorum pathways can still produce confusing logs despite disabled quorum semantics. It also states that writes still need to be blocked during commit. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-04-30) — https://example.test/withheld-reference
- [statement] If a primary-driven index build cannot be resumed, the server logs a failure and aborts it instead, so resumability does not guarantee every interrupted build completes. Sources: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/master/src/mongo/db/index_builds/index_builds_coordinator.cpp — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/master/src/mongo/db/index_builds/README.md
- [statement] The coordinator attaches interceptors for resumable builds before onStepUp returns and the node accepts writes. Its comment explains that an earlier write would otherwise be invisible to the resumed build. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-20) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/master/src/mongo/db/index_builds/index_builds_coordinator.cpp
